title: 第11章 富贵险中求第12章 这花我叶家要了
content_zh:
韩风在脑海里使劲回忆着关于池淮君的资料，只知道对方是结丹强者，鉴宝无数，眼力非常准。
别的就不清楚了。
他这个药草，给对方鉴定是不怕的，因为药效都是真的。
至于买家买走后，炼出来的丹药不管用，那就不关他的事情了，毕竟是你自己炼丹失败的。
但这种事情，一次两次还行，次次你卖的东西人家买回去不管用，就得露馅了。
很快，里面便出来一个人，喜笑颜开的，看样子是鉴定出一个好价格。
“下一个。”
里面传来了一道温和的声音。
闻言，韩风便推门走了进去。
一个装修典雅古色古香的房间里，韩风看到了一个青年修士，坐在一张桌子后面。
那青年修士，看着约莫三十岁的模样，面色温和如玉，嘴角挂着和煦的微笑，手中还拿着一把蒲扇。
“拜见池淮君前辈。”
韩风抱掌道。
“道友请坐。”
池淮君伸掌指向了那把椅子。
韩风坐下后说道，
“前辈，我想卖一株灵草。”
“第一次来吧？”
池淮君微笑着看向韩风。
“嗯，您怎么知道的？”

“经常来的，会在我说话前，便将五块灵石的咨询费放在这里了。”
闻言，韩风尴尬了一下，连忙取出五块灵石，放到了桌子上。
池淮君这才说道，
“寻常灵草，集市上便可买卖，能让小友到我这里来卖的，想来是比较珍稀的灵草吧？”
“是木灵三针花。”
“如此普通的药草，随处可见，那想必年份一定很高吧？”
“嗯，三百五十年药龄的三针花。”
闻言，池淮君微微皱眉，说道，
“谁会把那么普通的三针花养三百五十年啊？小友莫不是在逗我？”
韩风看了看这个房子，感觉差不多能放下，于是便从储物袋里，拿了出来那株三针花。
三针花刚一出现，便横跨了整个房间，让池淮君也微微有些惊讶。
见到对方惊讶，韩风用想好的措辞解释道，
“这株三针花是我无意间发现的……”
“你不需要告诉我这是怎么来的，拍卖场有规矩。
你第一次来，我便为你解释一次。
第一，宝物不问来路，是宝物就行。
第二，卖主不问身份，虽然我神识一扫，便可以知道小友是什么模样，但我不会去这么做。
第三，任何物品，由我鉴定过后，交给拍卖场拍卖，此后一切后果，由我拍卖场承担，与卖主再无任何瓜葛。”
“晚辈明白了，谢前辈解惑。”
韩风感激道。

他虽然聪明，但阅历太浅，很多事情都不知道。
池淮君点了点头，拿起这株三针花，目光凝神，仔细鉴定着。
“嗯，药力充沛，采摘后没有超过一天，没有流失，确实是三百五十年以上的药龄了。
content_en:
Han Feng tried his best to recall the information about Chi Huaijun in his mind. He only knew that the other party was a strong pill-forming expert who could identify countless treasures and had very accurate eyesight.
I don't know anything else.
He is not afraid of identifying this medicinal herb, because the medicinal effects are real.
As for the elixir concocted by the buyer if it doesn't work after buying it, that's none of his business. After all, it was you who failed to concoct the elixir yourself.
But for this kind of thing, it's okay once or twice, but every time what you sell doesn't work when people buy it back, the secret will be exposed.
Soon, a man came out with a bright smile. It seemed that he had appraised a good price.
"Next one."
A gentle voice came from inside.
Hearing this, Han Feng opened the door and walked in.
In an elegantly decorated room, Han Feng saw a young monk sitting behind a table.
The young monk looked about thirty years old, with a face as gentle as jade, a warm smile on his lips, and a cattail leaf fan in his hand.
"Meet Senior Chi Huaijun."
Han Feng held his hands and said.
"Fellow Taoist, please sit down."
Chi Huaijun pointed at the chair with his palm.
Han Feng sat down and said,
"Senior, I want to sell a spiritual grass."
"Is it your first time?"
Chi Huaijun looked at Han Feng with a smile.
"Well, how did you know?"
"Those who come here often will leave the consultation fee of five spiritual stones here before I speak."
Hearing this, Han Feng felt embarrassed, and quickly took out five spiritual stones and placed them on the table.
Chi Huaijun then said,
"Ordinary spiritual herbs can be bought and sold in the market. The ones that allow children to come to my place to sell them must be relatively rare spiritual herbs, right?"
"It's the Wood Spirit Three-needle Flower."
"Such a common medicinal herb can be found everywhere, so it must be very old, right?"
"Yes, three hundred and fifty-year-old three-needle flower."
Hearing this, Chi Huaijun frowned slightly and said,
"Who would keep such an ordinary three-needle flower for 350 years? Are you kidding me?"
Han Feng looked at the house and felt that it was almost enough to put down, so he took out the three-needle flower from the storage bag.
As soon as the three-needle flower appeared, it spread across the entire room, making Chi Huaijun slightly surprised.
Surprised to see the other party, Han Feng explained with the words he had thought of,
"I discovered this three-needle flower accidentally..."
“You don’t need to tell me how this came about, there are rules at the auction house.
The first time you come, I will explain it to you.
First, it doesn’t matter where the treasure came from, as long as it is a treasure.
Second, the seller does not ask about his identity. Although I can know what the little friend looks like with a quick glance, I will not do that.
Third, if any item is handed over to the auction house for auction after being appraised by me, all subsequent consequences will be borne by my auction house and will have nothing to do with the seller. "
"Junior understands. Thank you, senior, for clearing up the confusion."
Han Feng said gratefully.
Although he is smart, he has little experience and does not know many things.
Chi Huaijun nodded, picked up the three-needle flower, and examined it carefully with his eyes focused.
"Well, the medicine is full of potency. It didn't last more than a day after picking, and it hasn't been lost. It is indeed more than 350 years old.
